# Pipeline Secrets and Settings

**Generated by**: DEVOPS (`aire-devops-pipeline`), 2026-10-23
**Source**: `docs/deployment/discovery-report.md` (approved)
**Rule**: this file names every secret and setting and says where it lives. **It never contains values.**

---

## 1. GitHub repository (`FlaviaPop/FirstProjAire`)

### Environments
Settings → Environments → New environment:

| Environment | Used by | Protection |
|---|---|---|
| `staging` | `deploy-staging.yml` (moves the `staging` image tag) | none (automatic on merge to `main`) |
| `production` | `deploy-production.yml` (moves the `prod` image tag) | **Required reviewers**: the owner (and a second person if available) |
| `infrastructure` | `terraform.yml` apply job | **Required reviewers**: the owner |

### Repository secrets
Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → **New repository secret**:

| Secret | Used by | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `HCLOUD_TOKEN` | `terraform.yml` | Hetzner Cloud API token (project `learnplat`, Read & Write) |
| `HETZNER_S3_ACCESS_KEY` | `terraform.yml` | Hetzner Object Storage access key (Terraform state bucket) |
| `HETZNER_S3_SECRET_KEY` | `terraform.yml` | Hetzner Object Storage secret key |
| `TF_VAR_OPERATOR_IP_ADDRESSES` | `terraform.yml` | JSON list of operator CIDRs allowed to SSH, e.g. `["203.0.113.7/32"]`. **Required: plan/apply refuse to run without it** |
| `TF_VAR_OPERATOR_SSH_PUBLIC_KEYS` | `terraform.yml` | JSON map of key name to OpenSSH public key, e.g. `{"owner": "ssh-ed25519 AAAA… owner@laptop"}` |

`GITHUB_TOKEN` (automatic) pushes images to GHCR (`packages: write` is granted per job) and runs gitleaks. **SAST/SCA need no extra secrets**: CodeQL, pip-audit and Dependabot are built in.

### Repository variables (optional)
Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → **Variables** tab:

| Variable | Used by | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `STAGING_URL` | `deploy-staging.yml` verify job | `https://<staging domain>` |
| `PROD_URL` | `deploy-production.yml` verify job | `https://<prod domain>` |

When unset, the verify jobs are skipped; the VMs still deploy and roll back on their own.

### Branch protection
Settings → Branches → `main`: require a pull request and require the status checks **Lint, types, tests**, **E2E (Playwright)**, **Secrets and dependency audit**, **Docker image + Trivy**, and **CodeQL / analyze**.

### Container image visibility
The first push creates the package `ghcr.io/flaviapop/learnplat` (private by default). The VMs pull with a read-only token (§3).

## 2. Terraform (operator laptop, once)

```bash
# 1. Object Storage keys for the bootstrap (local state)
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=…  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=…
make tf-bootstrap                 # creates learnplat-tfstate-<suffix> + learnplat-backups-<suffix>
git add terraform/backend.hcl terraform/bootstrap.auto.tfvars   # no secrets in either file
# 2. Main configuration (or let terraform.yml do it after merge)
export HCLOUD_TOKEN=…
export TF_VAR_operator_ip_addresses='["<your-ip>/32"]'
export TF_VAR_operator_ssh_public_keys='{"owner": "ssh-ed25519 …"}'
make tf-plan && make tf-apply
```
Terraform outputs each VM's IPv4/IPv6 for the DNS records (§4). `terraform/bootstrap/terraform.tfstate` stays **only on the operator laptop** (gitignored); keep a copy in the password manager's secure notes.

---

## 3. On each VM (root, after Terraform)

cloud-init has installed Docker, age, rclone, certbot, the `learnplat-watch` timer (every minute) and the `learnplat-backup` timer (02:30 Europe/Bucharest), and mounted the data volume at `/data`. The operator adds the secrets:

| File (root:root) | Mode | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `/etc/learnplat/deploy.env` | 0644 | add `APP_DOMAIN=<domain of this environment>` (`LEARNPLAT_ENV` and `IMAGE_REPO` are already there) |
| `/etc/learnplat/app.env` | 0600 | `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY` (new random 50+ chars **per environment**), `DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=<domain>`, `DJANGO_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://<domain>`, `AXES_PROXY_COUNT=1`, `LOG_LEVEL=INFO` |
| `/etc/learnplat/backup.env` | 0600 | add `RCLONE_CONFIG_HETZNER_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `RCLONE_CONFIG_HETZNER_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` (keys scoped to the backup bucket) and `HEARTBEAT_URL` (backup-success check of the uptime monitor) |
| `/etc/learnplat/backup.pub` | 0644 | the **age public key** (`age1…`). The private key never goes on a server: keep it offline (password manager) and test a restore before the pilot |
| GHCR login | n/a | `docker login ghcr.io -u <github user>` with a **read-only** (`read:packages`) token |

First certificate (after the DNS records resolve):
```bash
certbot certonly --standalone -d <domain> --agree-tos -m <alert e-mail> --non-interactive
# renewals reuse the webroot served by the nginx container and reload it:
certbot reconfigure --webroot -w /var/www/certbot \
  --deploy-hook "docker exec learnplat-nginx-1 nginx -s reload"
```
Then `make deploy` on the VM (or wait one minute) runs the first deployment.

## 4. Still open (from discovery): provide before `aire-devops-deploy`

| # | Item | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Domains** (prod + staging) | `APP_DOMAIN`, `DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, `DJANGO_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS`, certbot, `STAGING_URL`/`PROD_URL`, DNS A/AAAA records |
| 2 | **Alert e-mail** | uptime monitor, `HEARTBEAT_URL` check, certbot `-m` |
| 3 | **Operator IPs** for SSH | `TF_VAR_OPERATOR_IP_ADDRESSES` |
| 4 | Volume encryption (Hetzner at rest vs LUKS) | `aire-devops-deploy` |

## 5. Hand-offs to DEV (application changes; DevOps doesn't edit app code)

| # | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Wire WhiteNoise** (`whitenoise.middleware.WhiteNoiseMiddleware` after `SecurityMiddleware`) **or** drop the dependency | It's in `pyproject.toml` (architecture: "WhiteNoise serves static files") but not in `MIDDLEWARE`, so with prod settings Django serves no static files. The pipeline works around it: Nginx serves `/static/` from the image's collected files |
| 2 | `python-ipware` + confirm `AXES_PROXY_COUNT=1` behaviour | axes must see the client IP Nginx forwards (`X-Forwarded-For` = `$remote_addr`, one trusted hop) |
| 3 | HSTS `includeSubDomains` / `preload` | 1.0 review ISS-004; decide once the domain is final (preload is hard to undo) |
| 4 | Audit-log purge after 12 months | 1.8 review ISS-004 + discovery retention decision; needs a reviewed, narrow exception to the append-only trigger and an audit row of the purge |
| 5 | Ruff security rules (`S`, bandit set) in `pyproject.toml` | Discovery SAST selection; CodeQL is already wired |
